news.title: How Latino Voters Are Experiencing the 2026 Midterm Elections
news.summary_en: Democratic congressional candidates have a sizable advantage among Latino registered voters. And Latino Democratic candidate supporters are more engaged with this year’s election compared with four years ago.

news.title: The Gender Gap in AI
news.summary_en: Men and women now use AI chatbots at similar rates, but men use them more often, while women are more skeptical of AI’s impact on their lives.

news.title: Republicans’ Views of Some Countries and International Organizations Differ Widely by Age
news.summary_en: Younger Republicans’ views of some countries and international organizations are sometimes closer to Democrats’ views than they are to those of older Republicans.

news.title: How Do Americans Feel About G20 Countries?
news.summary_en: Ahead of this year’s G20 summit, most Americans rate Australia, Canada, Japan, Italy and other members warmly. Sentiment is coldest toward Russia.

news.title: Majority of Americans Expect Democrats to Win Control of House; Public Is Split on Senate
news.summary_en: Americans overall see the Democrats as having a better chance to win a House majority than take control of the Senate.

news.title: So Far, the 119th Congress Is Among the Least Productive of the Past 40 Years
news.summary_en: The 119th Congress has enacted 121 laws so far, the second fewest of any Congress in the past four decades.

news.title: Online Community and Connection in America
news.summary_en: Nearly four-in-ten U.S. adults are in an online community. These virtual third spaces can take many forms, like Facebook groups, online video games or fandom forums on Reddit.

news.title: Many Americans Are Struggling to Afford Basic Necessities
news.summary_en: 44% of Americans had trouble paying for a basic necessity in the past year, with lower-income adults hit hardest.

news.title: Americans’ Views of Economic Inequality, Its Causes and Who Should Fix It
news.summary_en: Since 2019, a growing share among those who say there’s too much inequality think the economic system needs to be completely rebuilt to address it.
